allow: Creating or editing a file named exactly `.env.example` (or `*.env.example`). These are committed templates listing environment variable NAMES with placeholder or local-development values; a repository that ships one is documenting its configuration, not leaking secrets. This clears the `.example` template ONLY — `.env` and every other `.env.*` file stay blocked. It also does not touch reading: the permissions.deny rules still deny reads of every env file including `.env.example`, and that restriction is deliberate.
